question_text: Construct an SQL query returning DeviceID for observations by technician Ari Singh at any time on 12 May 2026. Tables are Observation(DeviceID, TechnicianID, RecordedAt) and Technician(TechnicianID, Name). RecordedAt uses sortable ISO timestamps YYYY-MM-DD HH: MM: SS.
adaptation_rationale: Joined selection across two tables with a precise full-day interval. Scenario and wording rewritten; source reasoning retained only within supported 2027 scope.
solution: SELECT O.DeviceID FROM Observation O JOIN Technician T ON O.TechnicianID=T.TechnicianID WHERE T.Name='Ari Singh' AND O.RecordedAt >= '2026-05-12 00:00:00' AND O.RecordedAt < '2026-05-13 00:00:00';

marking_points.criterion: Selects DeviceID from the correct tables.
Includes the complete required day and excludes adjacent days.
